\chapter{Diagnostic Code Reference}
\label{ch:diagnostic-codes}

Every diagnostic raised by TōSh carries a stable identifier of the
form \texttt{tosh.namespace.name}. User code may pattern-match on these
identifiers in \textbf{try}/\textbf{catch} blocks; tooling such as the
language server, the MCP server, and editor extensions key off them.
Non-error diagnostics can be suppressed with the \texttt{hush} builtin
(scope-local) or by adding their codes to
\texttt{\$tosh.Config.Diagnostics.Hushed}.

This chapter lists all 540 diagnostic codes currently emitted by the
implementation, grouped by namespace. It is generated from the source tree
by \texttt{scripts/extract-diagnostic-codes.tosh} and should be
regenerated whenever new diagnostics are added.

\section{\texttt{tosh.runtime.*}}
Raised by the engine while evaluating a script. The bulk of TōSh diagnostics live here.

\begin{description}[style=nextline,leftmargin=0pt,labelindent=0pt,labelsep=0pt,labelwidth=0pt,itemsep=0.35em,parsep=0pt,topsep=0.4em]
\item[\texttt{\small tosh.runtime.alloc\_negative\_size}] Allocated buffers cannot have a negative size.
\item[\texttt{\small tosh.runtime.alloc\_requires\_single\_value}] Allocated buffer declarations require exactly one size or type value.
\item[\texttt{\small tosh.runtime.annotation\_conversion\_failed}] '\{owner\}' produced a value that could not be converted to '\{typeName\}'.
\item[\texttt{\small tosh.runtime.annotation\_unknown\_type}] Argument '\{parameter.Name\}' could not be converted to '\{parameter.TypeName\}'.
\item[\texttt{\small tosh.runtime.assert\_requires\_predicate}] The 'assert' command requires a predicate block or callable.
\item[\texttt{\small tosh.runtime.assertion\_failed}] \textit{(see source)}
\item[\texttt{\small tosh.runtime.await\_requires\_future}] 'await' expects a future or a CLR Task.
\item[\texttt{\small tosh.runtime.background\_command\_must\_be\_external}] Background jobs currently require external command stages.
\item[\texttt{\small tosh.runtime.background\_pipeline\_not\_supported}] Background jobs currently support an optional input expression followed by external command stages only.

\section{\texttt{tosh.tui.*}}
Raised by the `tui` subsystem (terminal UI widgets, screens, providers).

\begin{description}[style=nextline,leftmargin=0pt,labelindent=0pt,labelsep=0pt,labelwidth=0pt,itemsep=0.35em,parsep=0pt,topsep=0.4em]
\item[\texttt{\small tosh.tui.filter.no\_items}] No items provided for 'tui filter'.
\item[\texttt{\small tosh.tui.layout.missing\_orientation}] The 'tui layout' subcommand requires an orientation.
\item[\texttt{\small tosh.tui.missing\_subcommand}] The 'tui' command requires a subcommand.
\item[\texttt{\small tosh.tui.no\_inline\_provider}] Inline prompts (--cli) are not available in this environment.
\item[\texttt{\small tosh.tui.no\_screen}] Expected a TuiScreen from pipeline input.
\item[\texttt{\small tosh.tui.pick.no\_items}] No items provided for 'tui pick'.
\item[\texttt{\small tosh.tui.run.no\_screen}] No TuiScreen provided to 'tui run'.
\item[\texttt{\small tosh.tui.unknown\_subcommand}] Unknown tui subcommand '\{subcommand\}'.
\end{description}
